mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer spending improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the quarters with positive GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 5% in a single month signals a weakening in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST decreased by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a single month, it signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.3% in a single month, it signals inflationary pressure during a tightening cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and retail and food services sales increase by more than 1% in a single month, it signals a strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 positive and RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 is positive and RSAFS increased by more than 1% in a month.
